visualCharacteristics.purpose: TAP's YouTube banner: a poster with the video's title and a play button; the video plays in its place
traits: 380 px frame with 32 px corners, the poster filling it
the title in white over the poster, a white outline play button at the foot
the YouTube player loaded only on play

contentPattern.structure: One row: the poster's cell (optional) and the text's (the title H3, the link to the YouTube video whose text is the button's). README.md.

usage: www.flytap.com's Economy Prime and For Life pages (ComponentBannerVideoModel with a youtubeUrl).
reuseGuidance: TAP only. Nothing loads from YouTube before the visitor plays the video.
